title: Image Orientation Fixer
description:
Turns scanned photographs the right way up. Finds faces at each of the four right-angle
rotations and keeps the one they agree on, so a print scanned sideways or upside down comes out
upright. It only acts when the evidence is clear: anything it is unsure about is passed through
untouched and listed on the text lane, because a photo turned the wrong way is worse than one
left alone.

input.description: A photograph that may have been scanned at the wrong orientation.

output.description: The same photograph, turned upright when the node is confident and passed through byte-for-byte when it is not. The stream keeps its original name and format.

JSON decision record: {decoded, rotation, confident, scores, faces, ratio, reason}. 'rotation' is the correction applied in degrees clockwise, and 'reason' names why an image was left alone, so the skipped set is reviewable without re-running.
